dedupe_keys.name: blockchain renewable energy communications security benchmark tables

description: This deposit provides benchmark tables for blockchain-based communications in distributed renewable-energy systems. University of Vaasa collaborators compare cryptographic processing and network resilience under several cyberattack scenarios. Mendeley version 2 lists twelve CSV and PNG files, including key-operation timings and resilience indicators against changing node and compromised-node counts. The article describes a Solana-based network associated with wind-energy communication; exact collection dates and a common time-series interval are not established. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The published file inventory contains aggregated results and figures, which limits reconstruction of raw traffic or verification of individual attack events. Coverage is limited to the reported experimental scenarios. The metadata do not establish an independently validated physical wind-farm response. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing overhead and resilience assumptions in electricity-communications simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network simulator, without a verified import route. No data files, blockchain transactions or security scenarios were executed.
